title: Completed local fibre comparison data
statement: In the setting of [def-zl-classical-local-frobenius-data], define completed normalization for a natural fibre comparison c using the SAME finite-stage realization isomorphism occurring in [def-zl-normalized-classical-weil-realization]. For each finite coefficient subfield E and geometric point x, take the pinned finite model, its completed-system comparison and its stage isomorphism. Choose normalized point realization and normalized pullback along x as in [def-real-lisse-realization-data], [def-real-lisse-point-normalization], [def-real-lisse-pullback-normalization]; these are witnesses in the normalization property, not extra assumptions. The finite-section comparison is the prescribed point comparison followed by the ordinary pullback comparison and extension to Omega, with only the canonical carrier-lift tensor map. The germ of a section v along a lift z of x is the image of v under the ordinary module-pullback unit of [def-per-continuous-rational-realization-data] for x, restricted along z. A completed section v represents an integral inverse-limit fibre element w when EVERY finite projection of w equals the reduction germ of v, using the canonical comparison of [lem-cbc-proetale-comparison-stalk] and the reduction cone of [def-per-lisse-completed-system-data]. After the pinned stage inverse and the section comparison inverse, c sends a tensor germ of b tensor v to a tensor (b tensor w), for every Omega scalar a and E scalar b. Define all endpoint transports using the literal finite-stage object equations; no arbitrary vector-space isomorphism is supplied.
